result.stdout:
Description:
  bbx - a flight recorder for AI coding agents.

Usage:
  bbx [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  init                Set up .blackbox/ and install the agent's hooks in this project.
  verify              Recompute the hash chain of every session and check the chain heads anchored in git commits. Exit code 1 on any mismatch.
  anchor              Print Blackbox-Head trailers for the session logs staged for the next commit.
  sessions            List recorded sessions.
  timeline <session>  Show a session as prompts and the actions they led to. Honors NO_COLOR.
  blame <file>        Show which lines were written by the agent, in which session and from which prompt.
  report <session>    Write an incident report for a session.
  investigate         Find the recorded sessions behind a commit and report the evidence.
  check               CI gate: check AI-written code against traceability and test rules. Exit code 1 on failure.
  hook <event>        Record one Claude Code hook event from stdin (called by Claude Code).
  guard               Check one PreToolUse event from stdin against the guard rules; exit 2 blocks it (called by Claude Code).

result.stdout:
Description:
  Set up .blackbox/ and install the agent's hooks in this project.

Usage:
  bbx init [options]

Options:
  --uninstall      Remove bbx hooks from every agent config bbx writes (.claude/, .codex/, .cursor/, .github/hooks/).
  --local          Write hooks to .claude/settings.local.json with the absolute path of this bbx binary.
  --private        Add .blackbox/ to .gitignore so recordings stay on this machine.
  --guard          Also install the pre-flight guard: a PreToolUse hook that blocks force pushes, deleted migrations and the rules in config.json.
  --agent <agent>  The agent to record: claude-code (default), or codex, cursor, copilot (experimental). [default: claude-code]
  -?, -h, --help   Show help and usage information

Usage:
  bbx anchor [options]

Options:
  --message-file <message-file>  Add Blackbox-Head trailers to this commit message file (used by the git hook). Always exits 0.

  --local                        With --install-hook: call this bbx binary by absolute path instead of 'bbx' on PATH.
  -?, -h, --help                 Show help and usage information

result.stdout:
Description:
  CI gate: check AI-written code against traceability and test rules. Exit code 1 on failure.

Usage:
  bbx check [options]

Options:
  --require-trace <require-trace>  Regex for requirement IDs (e.g. "REQ-\d+"). Every AI line must come from a session whose prompts, up to that edit, contain one.
  --require-tests                  Every session that changed source with AI code must have run tests or changed a test file.
  --base <base>                    Only check lines added since the merge base with this ref (e.g. origin/main). Needs full git history.
  -?, -h, --help                   Show help and usage information
